ex_STS: Sit to stand. Rise from your chair. Sit back down slowly.
ex_STSp: Sit-stand with pause. Rise from the chair. Pause halfway. Then rise all the way.
ex_KE: Knee extensions. Sit tall. Straighten one knee. Hold, then lower.
ex_QSQ: Thigh squeezes. Sit tall, one leg straight. Tighten the top of your thigh. Hold, then relax.
ex_TKE: Terminal knee extension. Hold the chair back. Slight bend in your knee. Slowly straighten it. Squeeze at the top.
ex_CKS: Chair knee bends. Hold the chair back. Bend your knees just a little, then rise tall.
ex_PSQ: Shallow squats. Hold the counter. Bend only as far as feels easy, then back up.
ex_WDS: Wide stance squat. Hold the counter. Feet wide apart. Bend your knees a little and rise.
ex_HB: Hip bridges. Lie on the bed, knees bent. Lift your hips up.
ex_CPU: Chair press-ups. Sit tall, hands beside you. Press down and lift your hips a little.
ex_HR: Heel raises. Hold the counter. Rise up on your toes. Lower slowly.
ex_SCR: Seated calf raises. Sit tall. Rise up on your toes as high as you can. Lower slowly.
ex_TR: Toe raises. Hold the counter. Lift your toes. Rock back on your heels.
ex_SLR: Side leg raises. Hold the chair back. Lift one leg out to the side.
ex_HAB: Hip abduction. Hold the counter. Lift one leg out to the side. Slow and controlled.
ex_HE: Hip extension. Hold the counter. Gently lift one leg back. Slow and easy.
ex_RKS: Reverse knee lifts. Hold the chair back. Lift your heel up behind you.
ex_WP: Wall push-ups. Hands on the wall. Lean in, push back.
ex_WPU: Wide wall push-ups. Hands wide on the wall. Lean in, push back.
ex_TPU: Table push-ups. Hands on the table edge. Lean in, push back.
ex_ARC: Arm circles. Hold the chair with one hand. Circle the other arm slowly.
ex_WTW: Wall reaches. Stand near the wall. Reach up, down, and out to the side.
ex_CRL: Wall rolls. Hands on the wall. Roll your shoulders and chest slowly.
ex_BRM: Brisk march. Hold the counter. March in place, quick and light. Breathe hard but stay able to talk.
ex_SBX: Seated boxing. Sit tall. Punch forward, one arm then the other. Fast and loose.
ex_SJK: Seated jacks. Sit tall. Arms up and feet out, then arms down and feet in.
ex_SSS: Side steps. Hold the counter. Step sideways, then back. Keep your knees soft.
ex_HDG: Heel taps. Hold the counter. Tap one heel forward, then the other. Keep a steady beat.
ex_SMB: Seated high march. Sit tall. March your knees up as high as feels good. Slow and steady.
ex_HK: High-knee march. Hold the counter. March in place, lifting your knees as high as feels good.
ex_WLK: House walk. Walk briskly through the house, arms swinging. Keep a hand near the walls.
ex_CTP: Counter plank. Hands on the counter edge. Body in one line. Tighten your belly. Keep breathing.
ex_BRC: Belly brace. Sit tall. Breathe out and pull your belly in. Hold, then relax. Never hold your breath.
ex_SEK: Elbow to knee. Sit tall. Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee. Twist from your belly.
ex_SBD: Standing side bend. Hold the counter. Reach the other arm over your head and lean. Slowly.
ex_SCH: Seated chops. Sit tall, hands clasped. Swing from high on one side down to the other knee.
ex_PTL: Wall pelvic tilt. Back against the wall. Flatten your lower back to the wall. Hold, then release.
ex_SKL: Seated knee lifts. Sit tall, hands on the chair. Lift both knees a little. Lower slowly.
ex_MIP: Marching in place. Hold the chair back. March in place, nice and easy.
ex_TS: Tandem stance. Hold the table edge. One foot in front of the other. Hold steady.
ex_HTW: Heel to toe walk. Walk along the table, heel touching toe.
ex_OLB: One-leg balance. Hold the chair. Find your balance on one leg.
ex_FBW: Rock forward and back. Hands on the wall. Rock gently forward and back.
ex_SBW: Rock side to side. Hands on the wall. Sway gently side to side.
ex_TND: Tandem walking. Walk slowly along the wall, one foot in front of the other.
ex_CBL: Cross-body leg lifts. Hold the chair. Lift one leg across in front of the other.
ex_STW: Tandem walk. Hold the counter. Walk forward, one foot directly in front of the other.
ex_SLS: Single-leg stance. Hold the counter. Gently lift one foot. Find your balance.
ex_WSS: Weight shift sideways. Hold the counter. Shift your weight slowly from left to right.
ex_WSF: Weight shift front-back. Hold the counter. Rock gently forward then back.
ex_THR: Toe-heel rock. Hold the counter. Rise on your toes, then rock back on your heels.
ex_F8: Figure-8 weight shift. Hold the counter. Trace a slow figure-8 pattern with your weight.
ex_CLK: Clock steps. Hold the counter. Step out like the hands of a clock. Front, diagonal, side, back. Return each time.
ex_AC: Ankle circles. Sit tall. Circle your ankles, slow and easy.
ex_NST: Neck stretches. Sit tall. Turn your head slowly, side to side.
ex_SST: Shoulder stretches. Sit tall. Pull one arm gently across your chest.
ex_HST: Hip stretches. Sit tall. Rest one ankle on your knee. Lean forward gently.
ex_CST: Calf stretches. Hands on the wall. Step one foot back, heel down.
ex_AST: Overhead stretches. Sit tall. Reach one arm up high and hold.
ex_CS: Calf stretch. Hands on the wall. One foot back, heel flat. Hold the stretch.
ex_WS: Wall slides. Back against the wall. Slide your arms slowly up the wall and down.
ex_NR: Neck rotations. Sit tall. Slowly turn your head to one side, then the other.
ex_SR: Shoulder rolls. Sit tall. Roll your shoulders slowly forward, then backward.
ex_TT: Torso twist. Sit tall, arms folded. Twist gently to one side, then the other.
ex_CY: Chair cat-cow. Sit tall. Arch your back and look up, then round it and look down.
ex_RD: Reach drill. Hold the counter. Reach up high and across your body, both sides.
ex_SHR: Shoulder rolls. Stand tall. Roll your shoulders slowly.
ex_SB: Easy breathing. Sit tall. Breathe slow and deep.
ex_BDC: Belly breathing. Sit tall. Hand on your belly. Breathe slow and deep.
ex_BOX: Box breathing. Breathe in, hold, out, hold. Four slow counts each.
ex_PSB: Pursed-lip breathing. Breathe in through your nose. Out slowly through pursed lips.
ex_BAW: Breath and arm waves. Breathe in, arms float up. Breathe out, arms float down.
ex_HS: Hamstring stretch. Sit at the chair edge. Straighten one leg, lean forward gently.
ex_BB: Box breathing. In four counts. Hold four. Out four. Hold four. Slow and easy.
ex_CD: Full-body stretch. Stand against the wall. Reach tall and stretch your whole body out.
ex_L1: Chair rise, hands help. Scoot to the chair edge. Feet back. Lean forward. Push with your hands and stand.
ex_L2: Chair rise, no hands. Arms crossed. Nose over toes. Stand up. Sit back down slowly.
ex_L3: Low seat rise. Sit on the bed edge. Lean forward. Stand up. Hands may help. Sit back down slowly.
ex_L4: Slow lowering. Hand on the counter. Lower slowly onto the bed edge. Take four seconds.
ex_L5: Cushion seat rise. Firm cushions beside the bed. Sit on them. Hands on the bed. Push up to stand.
ex_L6: Floor sit and bed rise. Phone in your pocket. A soft mat beside the bed. We go one step at a time.
L6_s1: Phone in your pocket. Stand beside the bed.
L6_s2: Hands on the bed. Lower slowly to sit on the mat.
L6_s3: Rest here. Breathe. Feet flat, knees bent.
L6_s4: Turn sideways. Both hands on the bed.
L6_s5: Push down. Lift your hips onto the bed edge.
ex_L7: Full floor rise. The whole journey, on the mat beside the bed. Any sharp knee pain, stop and use the bed seat.
L7_s1: Phone in your pocket. Sit on the mat beside the bed.
L7_s2: Roll to your side. Then onto hands and knees on the pad.
L7_s3: Crawl to the bed. Hands flat on the bed.
L7_s4: Stronger foot flat on the floor.
L7_s5: Push with your hands and foot. Stand tall.
safe1: Talk to your doctor before you start this plan.
safe2: Effort is good. Sharp knee pain is not. If you feel it, stop and sit.
safe3: Breathe out on the hard part. Never hold your breath.
safe4: Keep your phone in your pocket.
tip1: Belly tip. No exercise removes belly fat alone. Moving plus eating less does.
tip2: Belly tip. Smaller plates. Slower bites. Stop when comfortably full.
tip3: Belly tip. Put protein in every meal. It keeps you full and keeps your muscle.
tip4: Belly tip. Walk ten minutes after each meal.
tip5: Belly tip. No snacking after dinner.
tip6: Belly tip. A glass of water before each meal.
tip7: Belly tip. Swap sweet drinks for water or tea.
tip8: Belly tip. Sleep seven hours. Tired bodies hold on to belly fat.
tip9: Belly tip. Measure your waist at the navel once a month. The scale can lie.
feel_q: How did that feel? Top button, easy. Middle button, just right. Bottom button, too hard, or your knee hurt.
lvl_back: No problem. We'll take a step back. Slow is safe.
lvl_hard: No problem. Slow is safe. If your knee stays sore, call your doctor.
